boundary_note: Bounded first pass for all three frozen records in Iuka and Corinth Operations. Preserve per-engagement dates: Iuka September 19, Corinth October 3–4 and Hatchie's Bridge October 5. The live NPS campaign heading does not replace any battle interval. Opening personnel and exact effective command boundaries remain unresolved. Draft claims do not alter model inputs.

claims.rationale: No inspected return establishes matched personnel at a common opening boundary. Imported numerical estimates remain unchanged; this pass does not validate them as simultaneous opening forces.

claims.value: The frozen force field reads Detachment [US]; Army of the West [CS]; the live field reads zero. NPS names Hurlbut's '4th Brigade' joining Ord; Greene says Hurlbut moved with his division and calls the fight Ord's little command against the whole of Van Dorn's army.
claims.rationale: Formation descriptions without counts; the sources differ on Hurlbut's formation. Live zeros are not measured absence.

open_questions: Returns, the Hurlbut formation's scope and the command-transfer clock remain deferred.

NPS/CWSAC is one family; Greene is one retrospective history by a non-participant Union engineer officer, founded on the Official Records. Reports quoted inside Greene are not additional independently inspected families.
No automatic commander attribution, causal campaign score, morale/readiness number or battle/campaign double counting.
